blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `addCampaignPromotionsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step adds promotions to a campaign.

```ts
const data = addCampaignPromotionsStep({
  id: "camp_123",
  add: ["promo_123"],
  remove: ["promo_321"],
})
```
